page.content:
Chamber on Terminus where Seldon appears at crises.

How Time Vault connects

  • Location: Terminus — The Time Vault stands on Terminus.
  • Character: Hari Seldon — Seldon appears in the Vault at each predicted crisis.

What is Time Vault?

The Time Vault is the Terminus chamber that projects Hari Seldon at predicted crises, confirming or alarming the Foundation as history diverges.

Key threads lead to Terminus and Hari Seldon.
